Settlor builds software solutions for the title, escrow, and real estate industries. The Junior Web Application Developer builds, designs, and maintains web applications, troubleshoots defects, participates in code review, and collaborates across teams to deliver features.
Cloud Computing
Information Technology
SaaS
Cloud Data Services
No H1B
Responsibilities
Feature Development: Build, design, and maintain web applications that impact the full spectrum of the real estate industry, using modern JavaScript (Vue 3) and Python on the back end
Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve defects using sound debugging approaches, tools, and techniques, and grow your ability to anticipate problems before they ship
Agentic Development: Use AI coding agents as a daily part of your workflow, with the review discipline to catch what they get wrong before it reaches a customer
Craft & Code Quality: Participate in code review as both author and reviewer, and apply the design patterns and practices the team has established
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with product, support, and senior engineers to turn business requirements into working software
Domain Fluency: Learn real estate, title, and escrow terminology well enough to reason about the problems you are solving, not just the tickets you are handed
Documentation: Leave behind clear notes, comments, and documentation so the next person - including future you - can move quickly
Qualification
JavaScript
Vue
Python
FastAPI
Django
Flask
Web Application Development
RESTful API Design
Data Analysis
Real Estate Technology
Mortgage Industry
Banking Industry
Title Insurance and Escrow
Required
You do not have to have all the answers yet, but you do need at least a year of building web applications and a genuine drive to get better every week
You are comfortable with autonomy, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are willing to wear multiple hats
You have 1+ years ideating, building, designing, and maintaining web applications, and you take pride in producing high-quality deliverables
You know Vue or an equivalent JavaScript framework, and Python with FastAPI, Django, Flask, or an equivalent framework - and you have a proven ability to pick up new tools quickly
You use agentic coding tools to move faster, and you can explain every line you ship
You are genuinely curious about what is possible with the languages and frameworks we use, and you want to build an intuitive, cutting-edge web experience
You enjoy getting to the 'bottom' of things and identifying the core issue at hand, rather than patching the symptom in front of you
You work effectively across functions, communicate openly, take feedback constructively, and contribute to a positive, accountable team culture, even under pressure
You have a sharp eye for details, catch issues before they become problems, and maintain high standards of accuracy without losing sight of broader goals
You assume responsibility for your work end to end and follow through without needing to be chased
Our software platform is built around critical, 'system of record' data, so you need to be comfortable working with data sets and able to identify trends or gaps in them
A related bachelor's degree or commensurate experience
1+ years of professional experience building and maintaining production web applications
Strong working knowledge of a modern JavaScript framework and a Python web framework
Proficient in clear, professional written and verbal communication
At this time, we are only considering applicants who are already eligible to work for any U.S. employer without company sponsorship
Preferred
Experience in Real Estate Tech (PropTech) or Mortgage and Real Estate Brokerage
Production experience with Vue 3 and with FastAPI or Flask
Experience designing and maintaining RESTful APIs across internal and external integrations
Experience owning implementation decisions and technology selection on a team
Experience in real estate, mortgage, and/or banking industries
Experience in the Title and Escrow industry
Experience with enterprise SaaS at multi-tenant scale
Open-source contributions, talks, or writing that show how you think
Benefits
Rapid career progression as we scale our customer base and our company.
Full health benefits (medical, dental, and vision)
Matching 401(k) retirement plans
Flexible time-off program
Casual dress code: shorts, hoodies, and t-shirts are great.
Background music, afternoon board games, puzzle tables, and a fully stocked snack kitchen, plus occasional breakfast burritos.
Hybrid position based in Denver, Colorado: Monday and Thursday at home, Tuesday and Friday in the office, with Wednesday as scheduled weekly/monthly.
